units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:7">Esth. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>מלא ק׳ וכ׳</he> space for the whole length of a human body &c., v. <cite ref="Q01755"><he>פֶּרח</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:6">Gen. R. s. 12</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:12">Num. R. s. 13</cite> (among the seven things that were taken away from Adam) <he>זיוו וחייו וקוֹמָתוֹ</he> his beauty, his life’s length, and his high stature (which was diminished).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:12">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ של מיות</he>, v. <cite ref="M01106"><he>מֵיוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 45b:7">Bekh. 45ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>בעלי ק׳</he> men of high stature.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 60a:12">B. Kam. 60ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01442"><he>קָמָה</he></cite>; a. fr.—<he>ק׳ זקופה</he>, v. <cite ref="G00649"><he>זָקַף</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:9">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> <he>קומתו של אברהם</he>, v. <cite ref="S01442"><he>קָמָה</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>קוֹמוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4">Snh. VI, 4</cite> <he>שתי ק׳</he> the height of two men.
